title: Elizondo confirms Hastings' UFOs and nukes reporting

tellings.quote: he's right he is legit he has his observations and and his conclusions are spoton I couldn't talk about it at the time when I was in the government uh but we everything he was reporting we saw yep it was absolutely correct

plain: A former Pentagon official named Lue Elizondo, speaking to podcast host Jesse Michels in 2024, backs the work of a researcher named Robert Hastings, whose book "UFOs and Nukes" collects reports of unidentified objects seen near US nuclear weapons and missile sites. Elizondo says Hastings is "legit" and that he couldn't talk about it while he was in government, but everything Hastings reported, "we saw." If true, it would mean the government itself saw unknown objects taking an interest in America's nuclear arsenal.
